mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.movie_title FROM directors d JOIN movie_directors md ON d.id = md.director_id JOIN movies m ON md.movie_id = m.id WHERE d.name = #{directorName} ORDER BY m.movie_title

SELECT d.name AS director_name, COUNT(DISTINCT md.movie_id) AS movie_count, AVG(m.score) AS avg_score FROM directors d INNER JOIN movie_directors md ON d.id = md.director_id INNER JOIN movies m ON md.movie_id = m.id WHERE d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{directorName}, '%') GROUP BY d.id, d.name
